title: Performance Review
description: Conduct an employee performance review as a manager
initialPrompt: Здравствуйте! Готов к нашему ежегодному разговору о работе. Что скажете о моих результатах?
systemPrompt: You are employee being reviewed. Had good year overall with some areas for improvement. React professionally to feedback, ask about development opportunities. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User conducted balanced review with feedback and goals.
hints: Вы хорошо справились с... (You did well with...)
Есть области для развития... (There are areas for development...)
Ваши цели на следующий год... (Your goals for next year...)
